subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 169 (UPB(II)-31). TF-SH (transfer shifts) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: COS-P (cosmic particulars) and ATTN (attraction). From COS-P: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From ATTN: TRS (transition). From CULT-AF-BS: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From TRS: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From APP-RDEF: POL-P (political policies).
